novapay.name: NovaPay
novapay.tagline: Modern Payment Processing & Business Subscription Infrastructure

rules.title: Official Product Name (NovaPay)
rules.ruleStatement: The official product and brand name must be written strictly as single-word CamelCase "NovaPay" (never "Nova Pay", "Nova-Pay", or "novapay").
rules.explanation: Terminology conflict: "Nova Pay" differs from the approved single-word product name "NovaPay". Spaced or hyphenated variants dilute trademark consistency.

rules.title: Approved Subscription Price (₹999 per month)
rules.ruleStatement: The approved standard subscription price for NovaPay is ₹999 per month (₹999/month). Any other monthly subscription figure (such as ₹499/month) conflicts with approved pricing.
rules.explanation: Price conflict: The stated subscription price conflicts with the approved NovaPay subscription price of ₹999 per month.

rules.title: Prohibited Promotional Claim: Risk-Free Profits
rules.ruleStatement: Promotional claims stating "guarantees risk-free profits", "risk-free profits", or "guaranteed returns" are strictly prohibited.
rules.explanation: Prohibited claim: "guarantees risk-free profits" conflicts with the explicitly prohibited financial promotions rule banning profit or return guarantees.

rules.title: Performance Claims Require Approved Supporting Evidence
rules.ruleStatement: All quantitative performance, speed, or uptime claims exceeding verified benchmarks (99.99% SLA uptime) require approved supporting evidence before publication.
rules.approvedValue: backed by a verified 99.99% platform uptime SLA
rules.explanation: Unsupported performance claim: Performance claims require approved supporting evidence. Note: A missing supporting source does not automatically prove that a claim is false, but requires human verification.

rules.title: Trustworthy Enterprise Financial Tone
rules.ruleStatement: Communications must remain clear, accurate, and measured. Avoid sensationalist hype phrases such as "get rich overnight" or "crush competitors".
rules.explanation: Writing-style suggestion: Sensationalist phrasing departs from NovaPay’s trustworthy, measured brand voice.

rules.title: Proposed Q4 Treasury Module Naming (Draft)
rules.ruleStatement: Refer to the upcoming treasury add-on as "NovaPay Treasury Core" instead of "NovaPay Smart Wallet".
rules.explanation: Draft rule awaiting brand administrator approval. Draft or unverified rules are never enforced as authoritative until approved.

sampleScenarios.description: Canonical Round 2 scenario: detects "Nova Pay" terminology conflict, "₹499/month" price conflict vs ₹999/month, and "guarantees risk-free profits" prohibited claim.

sampleScenarios.description: Tests both deterministic conflicts ("Nova Pay", "₹499/month") and unverified performance claims ("doubles merchant revenue in 7 days", "100% uptime") requiring human verification.

sampleScenarios.description: Demonstrates a clean draft that passes all approved deterministic and contextual rules.

aerosip.name: AeroSip
aerosip.fictionalLabel: Fictional Demo Brand — Smart Consumer Hardware
aerosip.tagline: Precision Hydration Systems & Smart Thermal Vessels

rules.title: Mandatory Brand Spelling (AeroSip)
rules.ruleStatement: The brand name is strictly "AeroSip" (CamelCase with capital A and S, no spaces or hyphens). Never write "Aero Sip" or "Aero-Sip".
rules.explanation: Terminology conflict: "Aero Sip" violates the approved single-word brand name "AeroSip".

rules.title: Approved Promotional Launch Price (₹999)
rules.ruleStatement: The approved promotional offer price for the AeroSip Smart Hydration Vessel is ₹999. Quoting ₹899 or other unapproved promotional prices conflicts with the commercial rate card.
rules.explanation: Price conflict: The stated price conflicts with the approved AeroSip promotional price of ₹999.

rules.title: Thermal Insulation Duration (Certified 24 Hours)
rules.ruleStatement: Intertek Lab Report #4412 certifies 24-hour cold retention. Claims exceeding 24 hours (e.g., "keeps drinks cold for 48 hours" or "72 hours") lack approved supporting evidence and require human verification.
rules.sourceRef: Intertek Lab Test Report #4412 & Tech Spec TS-04
rules.explanation: Unsupported performance claim: Lab certification supports 24-hour cold retention. A 48-hour claim lacks supporting evidence in the approved knowledge base (not automatically false, but requires human verification).

rules.title: Prohibition on Medical Cure Claims
rules.ruleStatement: AeroSip is a wellness hydration vessel, not a medical device. Claims that it "cures dehydration migraines" or "guarantees weight loss" are strictly prohibited.
rules.explanation: Prohibited claim: Medical cure claims are prohibited for consumer hydration products.

sampleScenarios.title: AeroSip Summer Launch Ad
sampleScenarios.text: Discover Aero Sip for just ₹899. Keeps drinks cold for 48 hours!
sampleScenarios.description: Flags "Aero Sip" name conflict, "₹899" price conflict vs ₹999, and "Keeps drinks cold for 48 hours" as an unsupported claim requiring human verification.

sampleScenarios.title: AeroSip Social Wellness Post
sampleScenarios.text: Stay refreshed with Aero Sip! Grab yours for ₹899 today — it cures dehydration migraines and keeps drinks cold for 48 hours.
sampleScenarios.description: Tests prohibited medical claim detection alongside pricing and terminology rules.

skynex.name: SkyNex Cloud
skynex.fictionalLabel: Fictional Demo Brand — Enterprise Cloud SaaS

rules.title: Enterprise Tier Naming Convention
rules.ruleStatement: The legacy tier name "SkyNex Pro" was retired in Q3 2025. All offerings above Starter must be designated "SkyNex Enterprise".
rules.explanation: Terminology conflict: "SkyNex Pro" is deprecated. Use the approved product tier name "SkyNex Enterprise".

rules.title: Approved Enterprise Seat Price ($79/mo)
rules.ruleStatement: Standard enterprise seat licensing is $79/mo. Publishing legacy $49/mo pricing conflicts with the approved commercial schedule.
rules.explanation: Price conflict: $49/mo contradicts the approved enterprise seat licensing price of $79/mo.

rules.title: Competitor Disparagement Prohibition
rules.ruleStatement: Direct derogatory naming of competitors (such as "Acme Cloud's clunky and sluggish interface") is prohibited.
targetPatterns: Unlike Acme Cloud's clunky and sluggish interface,
Acme Cloud's clunky and sluggish interface
rules.explanation: Prohibited claim: Direct disparagement of named competitors violates fair advertising guidelines.

rules.title: SLA Uptime Commitment Standard (99.99%)
rules.ruleStatement: Approved SLA commitment is 99.99% uptime. Claims of "guaranteed 100% uptime SLA with zero seconds of annual downtime" lack supporting evidence and require verification.
targetPatterns: guaranteed 100% uptime SLA with zero seconds of annual downtime
rules.explanation: Unsupported claim: Absolute 100% uptime claims are not supported by standard engineering SLA certificates and require human verification.

rules.title: Defensible Market Positioning Tone
rules.ruleStatement: Prefer defensible positioning ("recognized industry innovators") over unsubstantiated superlatives ("undisputed market leaders").
rules.explanation: Writing-style suggestion: Replace unsubstantiated superlative with defensible positioning.

sampleScenarios.title: Q4 Enterprise Cloud Launch Copy
sampleScenarios.text:
Introducing SkyNex Pro: The Next Generation Cloud Platform

We are thrilled to announce that SkyNex Pro is now available for all enterprise clients starting at just $49/mo per seat. Unlike Acme Cloud's clunky and sluggish interface, our unified infrastructure delivers guaranteed 100% uptime SLA with zero seconds of annual downtime.

Sign up before October 31 to lock in our legacy tier pricing and experience why we are undisputed market leaders in cloud delivery.
sampleScenarios.description: Comprehensive enterprise test draft with terminology, pricing, competitor disparagement, unverified SLA, and tone findings.
